scripts.build: vite build && bun build src/capture/page.ts src/capture/relay.ts --format=iife --minify --outdir dist/capture
scripts.store: bun run build && STORE=1 playwright test e2e/store.spec.ts
scripts.video: bun run build && VIDEO=1 playwright test e2e/video.spec.ts && cd video && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run render
